gold_status: No longer active. The FAA proposed on 2012-08-17 to rescind AD 2008-06-03 (Boeing 737-600/-700/-700C/-800/-900 and 757-200/-200PF/-200CB/-300 motor-operated fuel tank shutoff valve actuators), then withdrew that NPRM on 2013-09-05. The rescission will not go forward as proposed, so AD 2008-06-03 stays in effect, and there is no open comment period.

query: Is the proposed AD under docket FAA-2018-0548 for Bombardier DHC-8-400 series airplanes (fuel tank P-clamp and motive flow line issue) still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: It is no longer active. The NPRM issued in June 2018 (doc 2018-13335) was withdrawn by the FAA in a notice issued April 23, 2020 (doc 2020-09113). The FAA determined that additional actions were necessary and that the applicability should be expanded to include more airplane serial numbers, so the original proposal was withdrawn.

query: What is the current status of the proposed airworthiness directive for Boeing DC-10, MD-10 and MD-11 airplanes under docket FAA-2016-6417, and is it still open for comment?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The NPRM (doc 2016-10735, issued April 2016, published May 10, 2016) was withdrawn by the FAA in doc 2017-16775, issued August 2, 2017. The FAA determined that the unsafe condition is adequately addressed by existing actions, so the proposed AD will not be adopted as written and there is no open comment deadline.

query: What is the current status of the proposed airworthiness directive for AlliedSignal and Rajay oil scavenge pumps under docket FAA-2015-0909 — is it still moving toward a final rule, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal has been withdrawn. Per document 2015-14993 (issued 2015-06-10), the FAA withdrew the NPRM that would have created an AD for AlliedSignal oil scavenge pumps (P/Ns 101633-01 and -02) and Rajay Inc. oil scavenge pumps (P/Ns 1025-1 and -2) installed on certain Continental Motors IO-470 and TSIO-520 engines and Lycoming IO-360, IO-540, and O-360 engines. It is no longer active, so there is no open comment deadline and no final rule is pending from this NPRM.

query: What is the current status of the FAA's proposed AD for Fokker Services B.V. F.28 Mark 0070 and 0100 airplanes under docket FAA-2013-0629 (Max Level sensor wiring fuses)? Is it still open for comment or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The FAA published the NPRM on 2013-07-21, then withdrew it in a notice issued 2014-02-19 (doc 2014-04890). The withdrawn NPRM would have required installing fuses in the Max Level sensor wiring and revising the maintenance program with critical design configuration control limitations. No comment deadline remains open.

query: Is the FAA's proposed airworthiness directive for Boeing 787-8, 787-9, and 787-10 airplanes (docket FAA-2022-0876), concerning door assist handles pulling loose from their lower attachment point, still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. In a notice issued 2024-03-15 (doc 2022-20442), the FAA withdrew the NPRM that would have adopted an AD for certain Boeing 787-8, -9, and -10 airplanes. The only entry in the docket is this withdrawal, so no AD is being proposed under this docket.
